i/import-antennas.note: JSON 解析エラーは upstream 同様 INTERNAL_ERROR。ジョブは mk-jobs
i/import-antennas.noteEn: A JSON parse error is INTERNAL_ERROR, the same as upstream. The job is mk-jobs

i/import-blocking.note: Import*ProcessorService を移植（アカウント解決は RemoteUserResolveService 相当、フォロー・ブロックは silent）。ジョブは mk-jobs（Cloudflare Queues）
i/import-blocking.noteEn: Port of Import*ProcessorService (account resolution is equivalent to RemoteUserResolveService; follows and blocks are silent). The job is mk-jobs (Cloudflare Queues)

i/import-following.note: Import*ProcessorService を移植（key=value は upstream 同様 index 2 から読む、silent フォロー）。アカウント移行直後は 32MiB まで許可。ジョブは mk-jobs
i/import-following.noteEn: Port of Import*ProcessorService (key=value is read from index 2, the same as upstream; silent follows). Up to 32MiB is allowed immediately after an account move. The job is mk-jobs

i/import-muting.note: Import*ProcessorService を移植（アカウント解決は RemoteUserResolveService 相当、フォロー・ブロックは silent）。ジョブは mk-jobs（Cloudflare Queues）
i/import-muting.noteEn: Port of Import*ProcessorService (account resolution is equivalent to RemoteUserResolveService; follows and blocks are silent). The job is mk-jobs (Cloudflare Queues)

i/import-user-lists.note: リストは解決前に作成、addMember（proxy フォロー含む）も upstream 同様。ジョブは mk-jobs
i/import-user-lists.noteEn: Lists are created before resolution, and addMember (including proxy follows) is also the same as upstream. The job is mk-jobs

i/notifications.note: 通知は Redis Stream の代わりに Durable Object（NotificationBox）に保存。ページング・フィルタ・既読処理・解決済みフォローリクエストの除外は upstream 同様
i/notifications.noteEn: Notifications are stored in a Durable Object (NotificationBox) instead of a Redis Stream. Paging, filters, read handling, and exclusion of resolved follow requests are the same as upstream

i/notifications-grouped.note: 通知は Durable Object に保存。グルーピング（reaction / renote、targetNoteId）と packGroupedMany は upstream 同様
i/notifications-grouped.noteEn: Notifications are stored in a Durable Object. Grouping (reaction / renote, targetNoteId) and packGroupedMany are the same as upstream

i/pin.note: NotePiningService.addPinned（featured コレクションへの Add をリモートフォロワーと LD 署名付きでリレーへ配信）
i/pin.noteEn: NotePiningService.addPinned (the Add to the featured collection is delivered to remote followers and to relays with an LD signature)

i/regenerate-token.note: main に myTokenRegenerated。接続中のストリームは upstream と同じく切断しない
i/regenerate-token.noteEn: myTokenRegenerated on main. Connected streams are not disconnected, the same as upstream

i/registry/set.note: domain の扱い（set / remove は truthy 判定）も upstream 同様
i/registry/set.noteEn: Handling of domain (set / remove is a truthy check) is also the same as upstream

i/unpin.note: NotePiningService.removePinned（Remove をリモートフォロワーと LD 署名付きでリレーへ）
i/unpin.noteEn: NotePiningService.removePinned (Remove goes to remote followers and to relays with an LD signature)

i/update.note: AccountUpdateService 相当（Update(Person) をリモートフォロワーと LD 署名付きでリレーへ）。MeDetailed の includeSecrets はネイティブトークンのときのみ（upstream isSecure）
i/update.noteEn: Equivalent to AccountUpdateService (Update(Person) goes to remote followers and to relays with an LD signature). MeDetailed's includeSecrets is only for a native token (upstream isSecure)
